name: 1.23.0-beta.21
notes: Fixing game errors: every error now has a Fix button. Pictures named after a variable with a typo (like “mox4dawn [dawb]” that should use dawn) are recognised: the variables that give a picture the game really has are listed first and marked ✓. Other kinds of error open the lines around the broken one to edit by hand (or, when the game has no script files, a place to write a fix).
The same error repeated on many lines (a picture that stays on screen) is listed once. Skipped picture errors stop repeating, as with the Ignore button.
Try it now reliably goes back to the scene with the error after the game restarts. Continue and the save list no longer pick Ren'Py's own error saves.
